title: Plasma against the 57-cell sequencing atlas
set_out: Read the 30 tuning plasmas again against the 57-cell IAM Sequencing Atlas, by the one command.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The first plasma against the 57-cell atlas
entries.what: One tuning plasma read end to end by the one command.
entries.outcome: Its islands read high, and its library floor is 3.6 times the atlas's; a floor check over all 30 was written before the other 29 are opened.

entries.title: The 30 tuning plasmas against the 57-cell atlas
entries.what: All 30 read by the one command against the 57-cell IAM Sequencing Atlas.
entries.outcome: Met-A at the cells' identity sites near 1 and the globe quiet; the islands read high, following each plasma's floor, several times the atlas's.

entries.title: The 30 plasmas with the common floor
entries.what: The same 30 counted again from their saved molecules with the common floor.
entries.outcome: The islands came to 0.9272 from 2.681; the domains, whole-sample Met-A and IAM-A are unchanged and still below 1.

entries.title: Plasma: the depth sweep
entries.what: Constructed healthy plasmas at stated depths, read by the one command.
entries.outcome: Normal at 20 reads; at plasma's 1 read, depth moves the domains only a few hundredths.

entries.title: Plasma: megakaryocyte DNA the atlas lacks
entries.what: Constructed plasmas holding up to a quarter megakaryocyte DNA.
entries.outcome: The control missed its bar by 0.001; megakaryocyte DNA lowers the domains only 0.034.

entries.title: Plasma: the domains follow the erythrocyte progenitor share
entries.what: The 30 plasmas' domains against every cell's share.
entries.outcome: Rho -0.928; that cell carries the most domain disorder in the atlas, and it is real in its own donors.

entries.title: Plasma: erythrocyte progenitors held out
entries.what: The 30 counted again with that cell held out of the Deconvolver.
entries.outcome: The domains came to 1.023, but Met-A at the identity sites rose to 1.109: the DNA is erythroid at identity sites, more ordered at the domains.

entries.title: The Johns Hopkins study against the 57-cell atlas
entries.what: All 36 merged from saved pieces and read by the full working chain.
entries.outcome: Every reading as in the second reading except the B-cell share, as expected for declared sorted B cells.

entries.title: A switch to hold cells out of the Deconvolver
entries.what: run_sample.py --dev-deconv-drop, diagnosis only, flagged in the bundle.

entries.title: Each cell's domain disorder from the one command
